title: REQ · Shutdown blurs focused scene objects and clears store focusedObjectId
summary: The SHUTDOWN handler removes focus from scene objects and sets focusedObjectId to null.
description: Context: the SHUTDOWN handler in BootScene.create leaves objects focused and the store id set. Desired behavior: blur every focused SceneObject and call useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject(null) during shutdown. Expected result: no focus remains in scene or store. Why: avoid stale focus after the scene is torn down.
acceptance_criteria: Given bookshelf is focused in scene and store, when SHUTDOWN runs, then blur is called on it and focusedObjectId is null.
Given nothing is focused, when SHUTDOWN runs, then focusedObjectId remains null and blur is not called.
definition_of_done: Shutdown clears scene and store focus
